title: Vegan Tofu Schnitzel with Freekeh and Za'atar Crust
subtitle: served with cabbage, tahini and amba
description: Marinated tofu slices dipped in a lentil flour batter and coated in a smoky freekeh and za'atar crumb, fried until crisp and served with cabbage salad, tahini and amba.

steps.text: Mix the water, garlic, lemon juice, 1 tbsp salt, thyme, olive oil and 1/2 tsp pepper in a bowl. Add the tofu slices and marinate for 2 hours (soft tofu) or up to 6 hours (firm tofu).
Grind the freekeh, za'atar, 1/2 tsp pepper and 1/2 tsp salt in a strong blender or spice grinder to a texture between flour and breadcrumbs. Transfer to a wide plate.
Mix the lentil flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp pepper and 1/2 cup water to a thick batter, about the texture of tahini.
Heat 1 cm of olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Dip the tofu slices in the batter and coat well on all sides with the freekeh crumb. Fry in the hot oil for about 1.5 minutes each side until golden and crisp.
Serve with chopped white and red cabbage, cherry tomatoes, tahini and amba.
